title: Mall World Theories
content: Since other people are theorizing, here's what my brother and I came up with the other day, while eating chicken and waffles in downtown New Orleans. So what's the Mall World? 1. Remembered Spaces. The mall world (and other places like the water park, train station, etc.) is simply a reflection of places we’ve visited. We generate it from memories. The feeling of commonality is an illusion. Communication is an illusion. It’s a typical social anxiety dream. Similar to the falling-down-the-steps dream and the naked-in-the-classroom dream. 2. Idealized spaces. The mall world is a shared construct, perhaps part of a universal consciousness. Or a Platonic ideal of a “mall.” Or an alternate dimension reflecting the world, like the upside down. How substantial is it? How does time function here? Can we communicate in the mall world? Astral project? Why not. 3. Imposed spaces. The mall world is a generated space where we are sent during our dreams. It could be a gaming or educational platform. Or a punishment routine. This theory requires a controlling domain. Are we in a sim? Are we inter-dimensional super soldiers? Are we communicating with aliens? Although the least likely, I really like the last theory: aliens are trying to communicate through our dreams. No joke. A lot of my mall world dreams have architecture, products, and styles that are twenty-years in the past (at least), implying that there may be a time delay in the signals sent back and forth. That's all I got. Oh, except, I highly suggest Daisy Mae's Southern Fried Chicken and Breakfast.
